_comment: Copy this folder to states/<two-letter-code>/ and fill every field. Delete keys starting with _ if you like; the viewer ignores them.
name: Your State
program_name: What the state calls the licensed, Medicaid-billing kind of adult day care
regulator: Agency that licenses it, and the rule citation
payer_program: Medicaid program name and how it pays (fee-for-service, managed care plans)
_bbox: [min_lat, min_lng, max_lat, max_lng]; the validator rejects coordinates outside it
billing_rules: One or two sentences: what counts as a billable day, hours required, days per week cap, who decides eligibility
spending_source_note: Where the spending series comes from and what it includes

narrative.how_paid: Markdown. How a center gets paid and who decides eligibility.
narrative.what_not_public: Markdown. What you could not find and how to request it.
narrative.assessment: Markdown. What the public record shows, with every claim sourced. No speculation.
narrative.geography: Markdown. Where the centers cluster and why, if known.
